assertion.n_note: `eligible_cues` IS the operator's denominator — the units a severity is a fraction of. The attribute counts below are a different population: mentions CARRYING the attribute, which one cue can produce several of.
assertion.note: `unmodified` is what ConText calls affirmed. The complement is `modified`, not `non-affirmed`: `historical` and `family` both affirm the concept and merely relocate it. `flipped_by` is null for `unmodified` because every operator flips INTO it as well as out of it.

span.by_category_note: shares sum to more than 1: a concept may carry several semantic types, so the categories overlap. See docs/phenotype-concept-table.md for the exclusive partition.

token.abbreviation_note: `ambiguous` is 2+ UMLS concepts carrying the surface as written, `highly_ambiguous` is 5+, and `sense_bands` is the distribution both collapse. Distinct from the free `short_form` shape count above: neither population contains the other.
token.concept_covered_note: tokens lying inside at least one concept mention, counted ONCE each — not the span count divided by the token count, which mentions overlap and vary in length make meaningless. Category rows overlap and sum to more than the total. Denominator is content tokens: punctuation is ~60% of `n` and no concept covers it.
token.near_miss_note: NOT a misspelling rate, and the measured gap is large. A near-miss is an alphabetic content token of 4 characters or more that neither vocabulary carries and is within one edit (Damerau) of a term one of them does. Adjudicated on 200 MIMIC-IV notes, precision is 0.425 over distinct surfaces and 0.096 over OCCURRENCES — the total above is roughly nine parts vocabulary and shorthand to one part error, because the frequent near-misses are words the lexicons miss (`refills`, `mellitus`) and clinical shorthand (`angap`, `eomi`). USE `distinct_hapax`: seen once in the whole corpus, precision 0.526. See docs/measurements/spelling_precision.json. Edit distance 2 is not reported — a complete index needs delete-2 neighbourhoods on both sides (15.5M keys), and an incomplete one would under-report by an unknown amount.
